::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
KriSemi Design Technologies, incorporated 2018 in Hyderabad. Primarily a design-services provider (~35 employees) to semiconductor and EDA companies, alongside its own IP work.
:::

## What does this firm design?

ASIC design services spanning analog/mixed-signal design, physical design, RTL verification, photonic integrated circuits, FPGA, and firmware for telecom systems.
